svg.text: DUAL-MODE 8-BIT RECONFIGURABLE ALU WITH 74LS181 VERIFIER & HIL TESTBENCH
Digital Electronics & Computer Architecture (DECA) · Hardware Interconnection Schematic

g.text: Select Inputs: S0 (Pin 11), S1 (Pin 10), S2 (Pin 9) | Strobe: GND (Pin 7)
D0,D1: Sum S_k (ADD/SUB) | D2: AND_k | D3: OR_k | D4: XOR_k | D5: NOT_k | D7: GND (CLEAR)
CUSTOM ALU RESULT BUS: Y[3..0] (Pin 5 of each MUX)
Select Line: From Hardware MODE Switch (Pin 1)
• Mode 0 (Compute): Routes Upper Nibble A[7..4], B[7..4] to 74LS181
• Mode 1 (Verify): Routes Lower Nibble A[3..0], B[3..0] to 74LS181
Function Select: S3, S2, S1, S0 (Pins 3, 4, 5, 6) | VCC: 24 | GND: 12
Carry In (Pin 15): Mode 0 connects to C4 from 74LS283 (Carry Ripple)
Mode 0 ──► Upper Nibble Y[7..4] | Mode 1 ──► Golden Reference to Comparator
Used on all 8 Y lines, Carry & Pass pins
